nodes.label: Brute-force Placement Search
nodes.rationale: Tries all 4 rotations x every x-position, hard-drops without landing, merges, scores board, unmerges; keeps highest-scoring clone as elite.

nodes.label: AI Heuristic Weights (height/lines/holes/bumpiness)
nodes.rationale: score = -0.51*height + 0.76*lines - 0.36*holes - 0.18*bumpiness; weights presumably evolved by a genetic algorithm (UI shows 'Gen: 50') but hardcoded here.

nodes.label: Human / AI Mode Toggle
nodes.rationale: humanMode flag; AI mode resets game and uses drop interval 1ms so AI plays at max speed.

nodes.label: BestScore = argmax over rotations r (0-3) and translations t (0-22) of P(r,t)
nodes.rationale: AI brute-forces every rotation/translation placement of the current piece and picks the one with the highest heuristic score P.

nodes.label: Placement Score P (weighted linear heuristic)
nodes.rationale: P = -W_holes*H + W_lines*L - W_AH*AH - W_bumpiness*B - W_bumpiness*B. Rewards cleared lines, penalizes holes, aggregate height and bumpiness. The bumpiness term appears twice in the image, likely a typo for a different feature.

nodes.label: Heuristic Weights (W_holes, W_lines, W_AH, W_bumpiness)
nodes.rationale: Weights are the genome evolved by the genetic algorithm.

nodes.label: Genetic Algorithm (Algorithm 4, labelled 'Generic Algorithm')
nodes.rationale: Lecture slide pseudocode included as the reference design for the evolutionary AI: evolve a population of candidate solutions until one has high enough fitness. Caption 'Generic' is likely a typo for 'Genetic'; slide title 'Backtracking with Inferences and Heuristics' appears to be the lecture section header, not the algorithm itself.
